responsibility: Own the first-tab interactive brain homepage and emit user intent when a brain region is hovered or clicked.
fallback_behavior: The Neural Architecture brain WebView is the default visible Brain Navigator tab. The safe fallback index is created only if WebEngine or brain visual creation fails.
notes: Patch 5 added a visible fallback Brain Navigator index as the first tab.
Patch 6 adds an internal Qt WebChannel bridge scaffold for future rotating-brain web content.
The fallback does not use QWebEngine or the 3D brain asset yet.
The web bridge emits regionHovered(region_id) and regionClicked(region_id) intent only.
Brain Navigator requests tab navigation through an injected stable tab_id callback, never through hardcoded indexes.
Patch 7 adds a QWebEngineView scaffold dry-run that loads local HTML and attaches the Brain Web Bridge without replacing the visible fallback index.
The WebView scaffold is created only through an explicit lazy factory and emits region intent only.
Patch 8 extracts the uploaded Neural Architecture brain mesh and visual contract into inert project-owned Brain Navigator assets.
Patch 8 does not wire the extracted brain asset into the visible first tab; the fallback index remains active.
The extracted visual contract requires the brain to fit available tab space and update renderer, camera, and projected markers on resize.
Patch 9 adds an isolated Neural Architecture WebView preview that loads the extracted visual asset through QWebEngine only when explicitly requested.
Patch 9 does not replace the visible Brain Navigator fallback tab and does not switch tabs directly.
The manual preview path is for visual testing of title, footer, responsive sizing contract, QWebChannel bootstrap, and extracted mesh asset loading.
Patch 10 adds a responsive pulse marker layer to the isolated Neural Architecture preview only.
Pulse markers are dark blue by default, turn live red on hover, show a compact label, and emit region hover/click intent through the Brain Web Bridge.
Patch 10 does not replace the visible Brain Navigator fallback tab and does not open floating explanation windows yet.
Patch 11 promotes the Neural Architecture WebView to the visible Brain Navigator default.
The safe fallback index remains available only as an exception fallback when WebEngine or visual creation fails.
Patch 11 removes the visible fallback index as the normal app-start view, so the page title comes from the Neural Architecture HTML overlay.
Patch 11 adds the actual Three.js brain renderer to the asset template instead of inert mesh-only HTML.
Patch 12 adds click-open floating Remember Box windows to Neural Architecture pulse markers.
Floating windows explain the mapped module and close on outside click or Escape.
Patch 12 does not open modules, switch tabs, or add direct navigation from the WebView.
Patch 13 scale is retained because the brain size fits correctly.
Patch 14 restores original mesh colors after the incorrect yellow occipital overlay.
Patch 14 treats x as hemisphere side, y as superior-inferior, and z as anterior-posterior for this mesh.
Patch 14 snaps pulse markers to mesh surface coordinates and projects them every frame so they rotate with the brain.
Patch 15 refines frontal, parietal, occipital, cerebellum, cerebellar folia, and brainstem marker anchors after manual GUI review while preserving mesh-glued rotation.
Patch 16 adds an explicit Open module button to the floating Fancy Index; navigation goes through region mapping and the injected stable-tab callback only.
Patch 17 hardens the Open module control as an explicit clickable button and retries once if the QWebChannel bridge is still connecting.
Patch 18 keeps strong references to the Neural Architecture preview bundle and QWebChannel bridge so the Open module button can reach the Python navigation adapter at runtime.
Patch 18 fixes Open module runtime delivery by keeping the QWebChannel bridge and preview bundle alive on Qt widgets.
Patch 19 records the final Brain Navigator interaction chain as a freeze snapshot without changing runtime behavior.
Final frozen flow: marker click opens the floating Fancy Index; Open module routes through QWebChannel, public region mapping, and injected stable-tab callback.
